name: Xingda International Holdings Limited
summary: Xingda International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and trades in radial tire cords, bead wires, and other wires in the People's Republic of China, India, the United States, Thailand, Romania, Slovakia, Brazil, and internationally. The company offers galvanized wires/wire ropes, steel cords, and hose wires. It also invests in commercial properties; and produces and supplies heating power. The company serves tire and hose manufacturers. Xingda International Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
